mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notices(notice_id, category, title, content, created_by, created_at, project_id, is_pinned, is_deleted) VALUES(#{noticeId}, #{category}, #{title}, #{content}, #{createdBy}, SYSDATE, #{projectId}, #{isPinned}, 'O1')
mapper.select: SELECT n.notice_id, n.category, n.title, n.content, n.created_by, n.created_at, n.project_id, n.is_pinned, p.project_name, p.start_date, p.end_date, r.role_name, c.code_name AS pinned_name, u.user_name FROM notices n JOIN projects p ON p.project_id = n.project_id JOIN roles r ON r.role_id = n.category JOIN common_code c ON n.is_pinned = c.code_value JOIN users u ON u.user_id = n.created_by WHERE n.is_deleted = 'O1' AND n.notice_id = #{id}
